requirement: Saudi Arabia (SASO) requires IEC 62368 safety compliance (IEC 60950 is no longer valid) processed through the SABER platform by an in-country Importer of Record, with EU test reports, user guides, a manufacturer's/importer's Declaration of Conformity (mDoC/iDoC), and an undertaking letter when required; no separate EMC certification requirement is on file for this category.

requirement: Serbia requires the same EU General Product Safety Directive / Low Voltage Directive safety and EMC Directive compliance as the EU/UK market, but the Declaration of Conformity must specifically be provided in the Serbian language rather than just English.

requirement: The UAE requires EU-standards-based safety documentation (DoC, test reports, certificates, user guides) and EU-standards-based EMC compliance; no separate wired/wireless telecom certification applies to this non-radio category.

requirement: Bahrain's safety and EMC requirements for ITE products follow EU standards; no additional certification document beyond that is on file for this category.

requirement: Jordan verifies safety compliance case-by-case at the import/shipment-arrival stage against EU standards; no separate EMC certification requirement is on file for this category.

requirement: Morocco requires a Certificate of Conformity (PVoC) for every shipment for EN 62368-1 safety and a Morocco-specific DoC for EN 55032 EMC.

requirement: Oman requires an EU DoC for both EN-standards-based safety and EMC compliance.

requirement: Zambia requires a PVoC Statement of Registration for EN 62368-1 safety compliance; no separate EMC certification requirement is on file for this category.

requirement: Algeria requires a CAP (Conformity Assessment Program) Statement of Registration / Product Certificate for EN 60950 / EN 62368-1 safety compliance; no separate EMC certification requirement is on file for this category.

requirement: Egypt requires EU DoC-based EN 62368-1 safety and EN 55032 EMC compliance.

requirement: Kenya requires a KEBS PVoC Statement of Registration for EN 60950 / EN 60204 / EN 62368-1 safety compliance.
